title: Earning Interest on Your World Blue Balance
summary: Explains that a World Blue USD balance earns 1.0% APY with daily compounding; interest accrues on eligible USD funds and is credited per statement cycle (only USD accrues if you move currencies). Also covers interest monitoring/export and World Blue referral bonuses: $300 per successful referral, $200 welcome bonus for the referred business, up to 12 per calendar year, typically credited 7–10 business days after qualification if both accounts remain in good standing.
faqs: What APY does my World Blue USD balance earn, and is interest compounded daily?
How is interest credited—does it follow my statement cycle?
If I move funds between currencies, which balances earn the 1.0% interest?
How can I track or export interest earnings for my general ledger reconciliation?
What are the World Blue referral bonuses ($300/$200), the annual limit (12), and when are they credited (7–10 business days)?
Do referral bonuses require both the referrer’s and referred business’s accounts to be in good standing?
